notes.title: Ball Wall goes 3D!
notes.notes:
As reported last year in December, Ball Wall will be transformed into a Full 3D game.
We are currently busy developing the game in Unreal Engine 5, and this promises to be a real spectacle.

And we are proud to present the first IN GAME FOOTAGE.
The game footage will be adjusted during development, so this is not the final result.

In April this year, Ball Wall will have existed for 1 year, and to celebrate this, we will announce in April when the Ball Wall 3D would be updated.

So keep an eye on it, more information and footage soon.

notes.title: Official Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]We have very exciting news for you!
[/h3]We will launch Ball Wall 3D in 2024, which is around summer.

Ball Wall 3D will have the same intensity as the current version, only now made in Unreal Engine 5 and full 3D.
The game will feature more maps and enemies.
An open beta will also be online before the release.
Until then, we will continue to update the current game.

More information will follow in the second quarter of 2024.

notes.title: Super Sale!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Super sale with 75% discount![/b][/h3]

Let everyone know that Ball Wall has a super Sale with 75% discount. 
For a week!

[b][i]What is Ball Wall?
[/i][/b]The ultimate stress test, or just for fun.
Can you avoid all enemies in time?
In this fun game you have to get as far as possible between the enemies and you can collect coins.
You can use the bottom wall, but also the top wall.
The further you progress in the game, the more types of enemies you will encounter.
You only have one chance to continue, if you're done you have to start all over again.

[b][i]What can you expect in the future?[/i]
[/b]We want to give the game a major update 4 times a year, including a restyle of the map and adding a number of enemies. 
They are also working on a bonus map that you can play.

The game will also continue to update in between.
For example, we will fix bugs.
Change difficulty level.
Add or remove number of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43932940/40ff9a36325d73d0728055e71093106a40a25aa7.png[/img]
